title: German Stir Fry
description: A German-inspired stir fry made with a variety of ingredients and spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the German spaghetti and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the ingredients are well combined.
Season with salt substitute to taste.
